title: Biomarker for Maroteaux-Lamy Disease (BioMaroteaux)
brief_summary: Development of a new MS-based biomarker for the early and sensitive diagnosis of Maroteaux-Lamy disease from blood
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Informed consent will be obtained from the patient or the parents before any study related procedures.
* Patients older than 12 months
* The patient has a diagnosis of Maroteaux-Lamy disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* No Informed consent from the patient or the parents before any study related procedures
* Patients younger than 12 months
* The patient has no diagnosis of Maroteaux-Lamy disease
